name: Terrent Amese
description: 'God' who created the original tribe to guard the Dark Heart of the Wood; rejected by the Sulaki.

timeline.summary: Terrent Amese fuses man and tiger to create the first tribe of tiger warriors to guard the Dark Heart of the Wood.
timeline.quote: who created the first tribe of Jamuraan tiger warriors by fusing the essence of man and tiger.

citation.text: "Terrent Amese". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ojanen leads the tribe in building the Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale as a place of worship and watch-post.
timeline.quote: Terrent Amese named the first tiger warrior Ojanen

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ojanen realizes his people are slave labor and Terrent Amese no god, and rallies the tribe to seek independence.
timeline.quote: He rallied his tribe behind him and tried to obtain their independence from their creator.

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Terrent Amese curses the Ojanen line, creates Ur-Drago to exterminate the tribe, and disappears; Ojanen fights the beast while the tribe flees Scarwood.
timeline.quote: Terrent Amese cursed the Ojanen line and created the monster Ur-Drago to exterminate the tribe before disappearing, never to be seen again.

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale Jedit learns the history of the cat warriors and that the ghost was Ojanen's lover; he slays Ur-Drago but is gravely wounded.
timeline.quote: Ur-Drago attacks Jedit and the tiger man manages to slay his foe

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Terrent Amese creates the first cat warriors to protect the Dark Heart, who build the Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale.
timeline.quote: Terrent Amese created the first cat warriors by fusing the essence of man and tiger

citation.text: "Scarwood", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedit convinces the four cat warrior tribes that Terrent Amese was not a god and negotiates safe passage through the Scarwood.
timeline.quote: Jedit was able to negotiate safe passage through the Scarwood for any cat warrior

citation.text: "Scarwood", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After being abandoned by Terrent Amese and his creations, the Scarwood tabernacle falls into ruin for over 900 years.
timeline.quote: After being abandoned by both Terrent Amese and his creations, the tabernacle fell into ruin for over 900 years

citation.text: "Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale", section "Scarwood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Terrent Amese creates Ur-Drago by merging a tortoise, a white-maned horse and a black bull to punish Ojanen's people.
timeline.quote: was created by the planeswalker Terrent Amese around 2600 AR

citation.text: "Ur-Drago", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: they worshiped Terrent Amese , their creator, whom they believed to be a god

citation.text: "Efrava", section "Efrava in the time of Jedit Ojanen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
